name: stockinsights-india-plugin
description: stockinsights.ai India equity research plugin with MCP access to Indian company screening, filings, financial statements, shareholding, announcements, and results dates.

interface.longDescription: Research public Indian companies with stockinsights.ai datasets. Provide your ChatGPT/Codex access to company profiles, current market data, financial statements, segment revenue, shareholding patterns, annual reports, quarterly results, earnings-call transcripts, investor presentations, corporate announcements, and results dates. Screen and rank companies by industry, market cap, P/E, growth, profitability, debt, or cash flow; compare peers and trace findings to source data and filings. A stockinsights.ai account is required.
defaultPrompt: What did Infosys say about demand in its last earnings call?
Compare the financial statements of Swiggy and Zomato over past 4 quarters
Companies who recently announced contract wins?
